description: This file defines the StreamingSessionActor class, an Akka actor responsible for managing a single WebSocket streaming session in the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles incoming signals, commands, subscriptions, acknowledgements, session management, authorization, and message publishing related to a WebSocket connection.

classes.name: StreamingSessionActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class that manages the lifecycle and message handling of a WebSocket streaming session, including signal processing, subscription management, acknowledgement handling, and session timeout management.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props configuration for the actor with necessary dependencies.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called before the actor starts; used to set up monitoring and acknowledge labels.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called when the actor stops; used for cleanup and closing the session.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior, combining different message processing behaviors.

methods.name: createIncomingSignalBehavior
methods.description: Behavior for handling incoming signals, acknowledgements, and command responses.

methods.name: createOutgoingSignalBehavior
methods.description: Behavior for publishing signals and responses to the event publisher.

methods.name: createPubSubBehavior
methods.description: Behavior for handling start/stop streaming requests and subscription acknowledgements.

methods.name: createSelfTerminationBehavior
methods.description: Behavior for self-termination related messages such as session refresh, JWT validation, and termination signals.

methods.name: handleTerminated
methods.description: Handles cleanup when dependencies like event publisher are terminated.

methods.name: logUnknownMessage
methods.description: Logs any messages that do not match known handlers.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Attempt to declare acknowledgement labels in the cluster to ensure uniqueness.

methods.name: determineStreamingType
methods.description: Determines the streaming type (e.g., EVENTS, LIVE_EVENTS, MESSAGES) based on signal properties.

methods.name: parseCriteria
methods.description: Parses a filter string into a Criteria object.

methods.name: confirmSubscription
methods.description: Handles confirmation that a subscription request was acknowledged.

methods.name: confirmUnsubscription
methods.description: Handles confirmation that an unsubscription request was acknowledged.

methods.name: checkForAcksWithoutResponse
methods.description: Validates header settings to prevent acknowledgements without responses in WebSocket context.
